selectedSource.fileName: Following the treasures of Brazil 14d13n 2027 ENG com 20%.docx

evidence: Full 4,269,951-byte DOCX checked including word/document.xml tables. 14 days / 13 nights and Rio → Petropolis → Ouro Preto/Mariana → Inhotim → Salvador → Praia do Forte → Foz do Iguacu agree with RU itinerary; Argentine side on day 13 agrees with the second country.

Days 1–3 Rio arrival, Sugar Loaf and Corcovado; day 4 Petropolis/road to Ouro Preto; day 5 Mariana gold mine and Ouro Preto; day 6 Inhotim and flight to Salvador; day 7 Salvador/Praia do Forte; days 8–10 beach leisure; day 11 flight to Foz; days 12–13 both sides of falls; day 14 departure all align.

Word 2027 specifies private English-speaking tours, breakfasts, transfers, Macuco Safari and Bird Park; domestic flights excluded from USD 1,200 per person. RU Congonhas and Russian guide wording differs, but confident tour identity allows Word content per current policy.

RU priceFrom USD 7,357 matches the 2-person half-DBL row. Full 2027 table additionally has 1-person SGL 13,846; 2-person SGL 9,708; 3-person SGL 8,846, half-DBL 6,495 and third-TRP 6,359. All six rows preserved for master; site prices unchanged.
